subject: [Redwood] Cross-company roundtable demo — pick a time

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@acme-data.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orbit-health.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: [Redwood] Cross-company roundtable demo — pick a time

Hi Helen / Samir / Lena —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood. We wanted to run a short, focused group demo + live Q&A that highlights two things: (1) predictable latency/cost controls for inference pipelines, and (2) our deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private) — with a few examples that map to the kinds of profiles you each mentioned during discovery.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Wed Dec 16, 10:00–10:40 AM PST
- Thu Dec 17, 1:00–1:40 PM PST
- Fri Dec 18, 9:00–9:40 AM PST

Agenda (30–40 min):
- 5 min quick intros and goals
- 15 min demo: live inference flows + routing/fallbacks
- 10 min short Q&A (we’ll surface cost tradeoffs and rollout patterns)

Please reply with the slot that works best for you (or propose an alternative). We’ll keep it tight and record the session.

Attachments: Redwood-Group-Demo-Agenda.pdf; calendar-invite.ics

If you’re comfortable, can you also say which environment you’d like us to highlight (e.g., dedicated GPU pool vs. private VPC)? That will help Marissa and Lauren tailor the short sample.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
